Rimba Raya Biodiversity Reserve Project
Project Document
Version 3.4

Title and reference of methodology applied
VM0004 Methodology for Conservation Projects that Avoid Planned Land Use Conversion in Peat Swamp Forests, Version 1.0

Table of Contents
1. Project Location
2. Project Boundary
3. Baseline Scenario
4. Additionality
5. Stakeholder Comments
6. Leakage Management
7. Risk Assessment
8. Monitoring Plan

The project location is in Central Kalimantan, Indonesia, within the mapped project area and project boundary described in Section 2.
The baseline scenario explains the expected conversion of peat swamp forest without the project.
Additionality is demonstrated through investment barriers and regulatory surplus.
Stakeholder comments were recorded during community consultation meetings.
Leakage management addresses market effects and activity shifting.
The risk assessment covers fire risk, reversal risk, and mitigation controls.
The monitoring plan defines the reporting period, carbon pools, and GHG reductions to be tracked.
Validation evidence includes a validation statement from the validation body.
